text_blocks.snippet: Long COVID, or post-COVID-19 condition, typically lasts at least two months and can persist for longer, often starting within three months of the initial COVID-19 illness, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). Some individuals, especially those with severe cases, may experience multi-organ effects or autoimmune conditions lasting weeks, months, or even years, according to the CDC. These effects can involve various body systems, leading to a range of symptoms.
